assessment: This serostudy of blood donors in Bolivia (a country with very high COVID death rates in 2020-21) provides useful insights on the successive viral variants of SARS-CoV-2 over 2021 and 2022. Using compelling antibody and neutralization assays, the authors describe variant specific distributions in the different parts of Bolivia. The main methodological advance is to use serology to understand variant diversity, which in turn helps deepen understanding of "hybrid" immunity from widespread infection (and vaccination).
